contracts: Selector 0x42 creates type 0x3C only when both player-collision gates are set.
Selector 0x5F creates type 0x3E when the type-0x3E gate is clear.
Selector 0x41 creates type 0x3F when the type-0x3E gate is set and the type-0x3F gate is clear.

All three handlers use the forward-slot allocator with ACTOR_TEMPLATE_BASE_ZERO, install the shared exit-response animation entry and ACTOR_MOVE_SHARED_TYPE3C_3D_3E_3F_RESPONSE, and set actor byte +0x29 to 1.
limitations: The promoted names identify the response-spawn contract but do not assign a user-facing object identity to the three runtime types.
The legacy selector-qualified names remain aliases for historical findings and references.
conclusion: The three gated interaction response spawners now have stable type-specific creation identities tied to their exact selector conditions and shared response assets.
